faq.title: How Does It Work?
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know to win at FanFest.
faq.contactViaMenu: Contact us directly through the support menu.
faq.q1: How do I join the pool?
faq.a1: It's very simple. The pool covers all matches from the group stage to the grand final. This is key: if your score falls behind in the group stage, you have great opportunities to recover in direct knockout matches up to the final! Just register, complete your 1X2 predictions, and validate your QR at authorized points.
faq.a2: It's an interactive real-time dynamic. You select your stats predictions (Total Goals, Corners, Yellow Cards, etc.) before the match. During the game, you experience the excitement of VAR and, when it ends, our system automatically processes your picks to generate an exclusive winner ranking for that match.
faq.q3: What is the World Cup Cyclone?
faq.a3: It's our innovative live draw system. It uses a demonstrable cryptographic random selection algorithm to choose winners among active participants, guaranteeing total transparency in every prize awarded by the venues.
faq.a4: Absolutely! FanFest 5.0 allows you to create exclusive groups for friends, veterans leagues, or even WhatsApp groups. They're ideal for competing in a closed environment with your acquaintances, managing their own prizes and rivalries. You can join up to 3 private pools at no extra cost; if you want to join more than three, you'll need to purchase one of our subscription plans.
faq.q5: Are there Private Pools for Companies?
faq.a5: Yes, brands and corporations can activate private ecosystems for their employees or clients. For example, a company with national offices can launch an exclusive pool to strengthen the organizational culture, with its own ranking and corporate prizes. Like personal pools, you can be in up to 3 private groups for free; for additional participations, check our subscription plans.
faq.q6: Can I start promoting if the tournament has already started?
faq.a6: Absolutely YES! The important thing is that participants register independently. Any business or private group can join and activate their members at any time, allowing constant promotion as World Cup excitement grows.
faq.a7: You earn points for each correct final result. In addition, each match has a technical "Valuation Factor" that rewards knowledge and helps automatically and fairly break ties.
faq.q8: What is the FanFest 5.0 Interactive Metaverse?
faq.a8: The FanFest Metaverse is an ecosystem of immersive augmented reality experiences designed for users to experience the World Cup in a unique way. It includes the Photo Booth, where you take selfies with themed World Cup frames and personalized immersive backgrounds, and Marcos Pro, an advanced multi-theme system (sports, Christmas, corporate, and more) to create high-quality images ready to share or print. All on your phone, with no downloads or additional apps.
